prompts: Edit this dimensional textbook image into the grounding stage of induction. Preserve negative rod at left not touching sphere, ivory ceramic insulating stands and style. Add a continuous copper wire from right side of metal sphere down and right to conventional Earth ground symbol. Blue electron dots on wire with arrow away from sphere toward Earth labeled 'Electrons leave for Earth'. Sphere now has net positive charge: four red + symbols near left surface, NO blue minus symbols on sphere. Rod retains negative signs. Remove old attraction arrow and old captions. Title 'Keep the negative rod nearby; connect ground'. Only other caption 'Electrons leave; sphere becomes positive'.

Edit this dimensional textbook image into stage after grounding disconnected while rod remains. Preserve negative rod at left and separated sphere right on insulating stands. Sphere now four red plus signs near left surface and NO blue minus signs. Show small detached copper grounding lead on far right with clear air gap from sphere and ground symbol at far end. NO electron flow arrows. Remove attraction arrow and old captions. Title 'Disconnect ground first'. Caption 'Rod stays nearby; positive sphere is isolated'. Do not show any contact between rod and sphere.
